description: Serena tree-sitter validation checks for OGZPrime. Run after every Mercury reindex to confirm the call graph stored in tree-sitter-foundation-set.json is still valid. If any check fails, the corresponding entry in the foundation set is stale and a new DeepSearch dispatch is warranted.

checks.failure_means: addCandle was renamed or moved — call graph entry core/CandleStore.js::addCandle is stale
getCandles return was changed to deep copy or direct reference — Finding 5/6 risk profile changed
resolver was refactored — Finding 2 analysis is stale
priceHistory getter removed or renamed — shallow-copy boundary changed

checks.assertion: method _ema exists with period-based SMA seed
checks.failure_means: EMA formula changed — oracle pseudocode in Deliverable 7 is stale

checks.assertion: pairs array hardcodes 5 MA pair objects
checks.failure_means: EMA pairs changed — Phase 0 oracle inputs changed (NON-DETERM resolution in D6 stale)

checks.assertion: method reducePosition exists at approximately line 714
checks.failure_means: reducePosition was merged into closePosition — 4-layer bug analysis in D4 needs re-verification

checks.assertion: fromBrokerSymbol returns slash form (slash flag still present)
checks.failure_means_if_match_count_changes: BinanceAdapter fromBrokerSymbol was fixed — FLAG 1 in D5 matrix is resolved; update D5

checks.assertion: initialBalance reads from INITIAL_BALANCE env with default 10000
checks.failure_means: Initial balance default or env key changed — D7 oracle inputs stale

serena_blind_spots.pattern: Dynamic dispatch in OrderRouter.getAllPositions — adapter.getPositions() called via forEach
serena_blind_spots.why_blind: tree-sitter resolves static method names only; runtime polymorphism on adapter instances requires type inference
serena_blind_spots.resolution: Mercury RAG or DeepSearch for 'getPositions' across all adapters

serena_blind_spots.pattern: Inline arrow function strategy lambdas in StrategyOrchestrator._initStrategies
serena_blind_spots.why_blind: Arrow functions in push() calls have no name — getCallers/getCallees require named declarations
serena_blind_spots.resolution: Search by parent push() call site (line 191) + content match 'emaCrossoverModule.update'

serena_blind_spots.pattern: Map.size === 1 silent fallback in CandleProcessor._resolveSymCtx line 70
serena_blind_spots.why_blind: tree-sitter can locate the conditional expression but cannot evaluate the semantic meaning (arbitrary-first-element fallback)
serena_blind_spots.resolution: Mercury retrieves the pattern description from ogz-meta/specs/; DeepSearch for architectural analysis

serena_blind_spots.pattern: MaxProfitManager instance Map keyed by orderId (DEC-008)
serena_blind_spots.why_blind: Map instantiation and keying is dynamic runtime behavior; tree-sitter sees Map.set() calls but not the semantics of the key
